title: Helix admin CLI + runbooks-as-tasks: integrate support automation workflows
creator: Asha Patel
description: Build 'Helix' — a lightweight admin utilities suite that exposes safe operator primitives (user impersonation token rotation, model route drains, capacity rebinds) via a CLI and a minimal web UI, and a runbooks-as-tasks system so on-call engineers can execute documented remediation steps as tracked linear tasks. This ticket covers: design of CLI permissions, runbook task schema, Slack/Service Desk automation hooks for automatic incident triage, and the first integration with the support automation engine to run a subset of low-risk runbooks automatically. Goals: reduce mean time to resolution for SLO-impacting incidents by 30%, cut busywork on PagerDuty pages, and create audit-ready traces for every operator action.
